product: Genie Search is now generally available
tagline: Genie Search is now generally available.
what_it_does: Genie Search is now generally available. Genie Search indexes your organization's knowledge in sources such as Google Drive, Jira, Confluence, and Workday, so Genie One can search all of that knowledge in one place. Databricks indexes each document's permissions with its content and keeps both current, so users see only the documents that they can already access in the source.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
